qualification: Six signed and committed disposable-local cases using pinned current DAO and CP binaries. The two source transactions are paired with later snapshots, restored historical balances, and synthetic signer/ATAs. The source-era positive control pins stable success fields, since full local receipt hashes vary with Surfpool clock/account bytes. Alternate config fee sections and state/input edits are synthetic. This bounds the tested CP6067 behavior and does not prove current live exposure, permanent lock, or that every conceivable route fails.
